homonyms.basis: the MMRS record carries no disambiguation for this entity (census row without a 'disambiguation' field); no card at T1 is a homonym: every card is MIT's, the paper's, or the published article. Near names kept apart: airisk.io, another database of AI risks the repository's own FAQ names (F52); 'AIRI', the Initiative's abbreviation (F34, F56). The sibling entities are distinct entities, kept as relations, never senses of the name: the MIT AI Incident Tracker (its own /non row, composed in parallel; the MMRS record's 'part_of', MMRS-20), the MIT AI Risk Navigator (a census candidate, MMRS-23; B5), the AI Incident Database (the record's neighbour, MMRS-19), and the Initiative's other workstreams (AI Governance Map, Mitigation Map, priorities survey; F36).

captures.description: THE MIT AI RISK REPOSITORY, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a living, open-access database developed by MIT FutureTech' cataloguing over 1,700 risks from more than 65 frameworks; the causal taxonomy (entity, intent, timing), with 'roughly 38% to 42%' of risks said to stem from AI systems (the paper gives 38% to human decisions and 42% to AI systems); the domain taxonomy of seven domains and 24 subdomains, listed; connected tools, the MIT AI Risk Navigator and the Incident Tracker. Ten cards, seven MIT's own, with the arXiv paper (2408.12622) and ScienceDirect.
